title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
synopsis: An ape, a bone, a black slab, an indifferent computer, and a hotel room at the edge of forever.

nodes.text: A water hole, another tribe, a bone you have just learned to swing.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Brave.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Mercy—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: A black slab humming at sunrise.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Touch it.” The story records the instinct as “Curious” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honor—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: A dig site on the moon with a slab at its bottom.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Wise.
There is no taking “Touch” back. Reckless shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: The slab screams a frequency aimed at Jupiter.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Cover your ears” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Listen” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Brave.

nodes.text: A taped message about a third briefing only HAL has seen.

Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You hang in orbit as something both newer and older, looking down on a planet that does not yet know it has been edited.
You live a thousand quiet meals in a white room and you are not lonely, because every guest is a version of you.
You leave HAL's last card in place and you and the computer make peace, and the ship coasts toward Jupiter at a kinder pace, both of you humming.
